design.colorMode: black and white with original burgundy brand accent

decisions: Preserve homepage section order and five-page structure.
User rejected forest, gold, serif and empty illustrated placeholders. Replace with black/white performance direction, condensed bold headlines and orange accents.
Buttons use stronger solid fills, raised edges, hover lift and a single light sweep. Keep clear press/focus states and respect reduced motion.
Use original Jay Marson logo, Courage To Grow identity, burgundy #a8323b and media downloaded from growwithjay.co.uk. Preserve enhanced button effects and omit DBS and client count claims.

Use a single-row mobile/tablet header with a vertical, scrollable navigation panel, large tap targets, outside/Escape closing and breakpoint reset. Verify all five pages at phone, tablet, landscape and desktop widths.
